about: FlowScript v3 rendering cases (section 14 of flowscript-v3.md). natural: the v2 source renders as v3; call: the call form is kept; roundtrip: a v3-only form renders back unchanged. Each case: render, read back, same definition (D2 = D3), and render(read(v3)) = v3.
status: draft L3a 2026-11-18; executed by the v3 renderer (L2) and the conformance test (L4)

cases.why: a set of a local or result path is an assignment; no declaration is inferred
an if alone in else is written else if
default bounds
current becomes item in its own body; a bare return in a loop body goes to the next item, as continue
an inner loop takes the first free name
the catch parameter is named after the error local, read only inside the catch
filter and map with the item as arrow parameter; an object select is parenthesized
list.sort with compare keeps the JavaScript comparator (compare is added in L1b)
the new list.find, list.some and list.every blocks
push and put on typed collections
object.keys, object.values, json.parse and json.stringify captured by an assignment
a disabled statement keeps its natural form with the directive
list.sort without compare keeps its Flow order, which no JavaScript comparator reproduces
bounds other than the default need the call form
the error goes to a result path, which a catch parameter cannot name
the error local is read after the try, where a catch parameter does not exist
a per-item block in select has no arrow form
a filter without where has no arrow to write
a loop created without items
an object literal condition is always true in JavaScript
pretty given by an expression
an explicit name that is not a JavaScript label
a block inside the property of another block is not a statement: json.stringify stays a call (v2 accepts a block inside a per-item property only)
a block without a natural form: its call is its JavaScript
